layouts.name: Nudi
layouts.description: The numbered ANSI Nudi fonts up to version 5, such as Nudi 01 e and Nudi 05 k, Nudi Akshara, and Baraha's BRH fonts for Kannada, which share 1 layout.

layouts.name: Akruti
layouts.description: Akruti's Kannada fonts in the AkrutiKndPadma family and its weights.

layouts.name: Shree-Lipi
layouts.description: Shree-Lipi's Shree-Kan-0850 font and its styles. Other Shree-Kan numbers have layouts of their own with no table yet.

layouts.name: Nudi B-Akshara
layouts.description: Nudi B-Akshara (NudiB-Akshar), the bilingual Nudi font: Latin at the ASCII codes, Kannada from 81 up.

layouts.name: Kan-Eng
layouts.description: The bilingual Kan-Eng fonts, which share 1 layout: Latin at the ASCII letter codes and Kannada at the other codes.
